differences.name: Aboriginal Dreamings Gallery
differences.reason: Commercial Aboriginal art gallery and shop; a retail business, though listed by VisitCanberra and Wikivoyage.

differences.name: Brindabella Hills Winery
differences.reason: One cellar door among many; Hall wineries are named as a group, not singled out as a destination in its own right (run rule).

differences.name: Parliamentary Triangle
differences.reason: A precinct whose institutions are separate spots; Wikivoyage names it as the district to walk, but as a spot it overlaps those. Case for: two counted sources and a Wikipedia tourist-attraction category. Case against: an area, not a place with one thing to see.
